lure: A security warning says the computer is infected
ask: Call a support number shown in the pop-up

message.subject: Screenshot of a browser pop-up
message.body: Screenshot text: MICROSOFT SECURITY WARNING. Your computer is infected. Call Microsoft support now at 1-555-0166. Do not close this window.

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: This is not Microsoft.
reasons: Microsoft never shows a phone number in a warning.
Close the window; nothing is infected.
